subject.title: [Bug]: TLS certificate pin mismatch loop when connecting through Cloudflare Tunnel/Access (anycast edge certs)

question: For CA-valid manual remote domains, should iOS replace single-leaf pinning with hostname validation plus authenticated gateway-identity binding, and how should existing stored pins migrate?
rationale: The leaf pin is an intentional anti-impersonation boundary, but it is not a durable identity for an anycast TLS terminator; automation cannot safely choose its replacement or upgrade semantics.

options.title: Bind domain and gateway identity
options.body: Use system CA/hostname validation plus the authenticated paired gateway identity, with an explicit migration confirmation for existing pins.

options.title: Support a bounded pin set
options.body: Allow several explicitly trusted leaf fingerprints per endpoint, accepting continued rotation-management complexity and weaker durability.

options.title: Keep single-leaf pinning
options.body: Retain the current boundary and explicitly document Cloudflare Tunnel/Access anycast endpoints as unsupported for iOS Remote Domain mode.

recommendation.title: Bind domain and gateway identity
recommendation.body: Use system CA/hostname validation plus the authenticated paired gateway identity, with an explicit migration confirmation for existing pins.

likelyOwner.reason: This contributor authored the current rotated-certificate recovery behavior and is the closest feature-history owner for the immediate decision.
